Provider: PSIT Kanpur

Description: The PSIT CSE Merit Excellence Award 2026 provides financial support to enrolled Computer Science & Engineering students at PSIT Kanpur. Applicants must possess a minimum academic score of 80% and a family income under 300,000 INR. Selected recipients are awarded 45,000 INR.

Scholarship: KIT Tech Innovators Grant 2026

Provider: KIT Kanpur

Description: The KIT Tech Innovators Grant 2026 is available for undergraduate Information Technology students at KIT Kanpur. Applicants must belong to the OBC category with a minimum academic score of 75% and an annual family income below 250000 INR. The grant provides a financial assistance amount of 50000 INR.

Scholarship: UP Post-Matric Dashmottar Fee Reimbursement Scheme 2026

Provider: UP Government

Description: The UP Post-Matric Dashmottar Fee Reimbursement Scheme 2026 provides financial support to students enrolled in B.Tech, Diploma, or higher education programs in Uttar Pradesh. Eligible candidates must have achieved a minimum of 60% academically and have a household annual income under 200,000 INR. Beneficiaries receive an annual allowance of 50,000 INR.
